description: Global daily ELSE_GPCC runoff in annual NetCDF files
data_source: ELSE_GPCC runoff product associated with Kim et al. (2009)
access_notes: Separate cmf_v5_package_data/inp/ELSE_GPCC store; local copies are Git-ignored. Former ELSE_GPCC_nc directory renamed by maintainer. Redistribution conditions remain unconfirmed.
notes: Maintainer reports annual files for 1979-2010. Header-only inspection of runoff2000.nc confirms 366 time records, latitude=180, longitude=360, float32 runoff(time,latitude,longitude), mm day-1, missing_value=-999 and daily time bounds. Grid settings derive from the existing global source specification; coordinate values, data values and model ingestion were not validated in this rename task. The former Binary directory was removed; Binary extraction scripts require a separately configured source. Global runoff-grid tag: test-1deg (360 x 180; longitude centers -179.5..179.5; latitude centers 89.5..-89.5; NtoS). Use diminfo_test-1deg.nml and inpmat_test-1deg.bin prepared separately for each CaMa-Flood model map. The same grid pair is used with map/data/ELSE_GPCC_clm-1981-2010.one, the annual-mean runoff climatology in mm/s for channel-parameter estimation; annual runoffYYYY.nc contains daily runoff in mm day-1. The tag identifies spatial geometry, not file format, period or units. Regional repo-mek_1deg and repo-mek_1deg_bin use the separate 20 x 30 repo-mek_1deg mapping; ERA5-Land uses its own grid tag. Coordinate metadata were compared between external runoff2000.nc and the climatology NetCDF; this does not establish model-ingestion or scientific validation.
